name: Nana
source:
The serious type. Therefore, sometimes she can seem a little snarky or cold-hearted. She's also more or less an idealist, and sometimes can get a little spacey.

Is very cute when she's sleepy.

Likes: Stuffed animals, jam, tea, cucumbers.

Dislikes: Coffee (too bitter), hot milk (thinks it's smelly)
